summary: Reading the gold-detection scroll reaches read.c:seffect_gold_detection, but JavaScript records an unported gap and falls through to the later call-name prompt. C calls detect.c:gold_detect, draws rn2(19) while exercising wisdom, displays a temporary map of floor and carried gold, and waits for a key. Port the whole gold-detection function and wire its consumed return through the read effect; retain cursed/confused trap detection and failure consumption.

source.branch: read.c:seffect_gold_detection (2035-2043) routes confused or cursed scrolls to detect.c:trap_detect and ordinary scrolls to detect.c:gold_detect, consuming either return to clear the scroll pointer on strange_feeling failure. The selected ordinary case has visible floor gold; detect.c:gold_detect (335-469) builds the temporary gold map, says “You feel very greedy, and sense gold!”, exercises wisdom, browses the map, then restores it.
callers: read.c:seffects SCR_GOLD_DETECTION dispatches this effect after the scroll disappears; js/read.js currently calls note_unported and leaves the map/message path undone.
dependencies: Port return-valued detect.c:gold_detect as a whole, including stale-map cleanup, floor and monster-carried gold, no-gold and underfoot outcomes, temporary map, wisdom exercise, browse_map, and map_redisplay.
detect.c:trap_detect already has a JavaScript implementation for the cursed/confused branch, but it is not exported or wired to read.c; preserve its consumed 1/0 result.
Preserve the scroll pointer clearing on strange_feeling failure and the later learnscroll/consumption behavior in read.c.

evidence: Saved challenges/evaluations/20260927191056-v9.json reports 30/31 screens, 2745/2746 RNG calls, and 30/31 cursors. The focused scan at current HEAD locates segment 0 step 30; C has rn2(19)=17 from exercise(attrib.c:509), while JS has no corresponding draw.
Independent local replay of the admitted recording shows C step 30 top line “You feel very greedy, and sense gold!--More--” with mapped gold, while JS displays “Call a scroll labeled KO BATE:”.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c lines 2035-2043 and nethack-c/upstream/src/detect.c lines 335-469 define the consumed detection return and gold-map path; js/read.js SCR_GOLD_DETECTION arm at line 1804 records the gap.
